expectations.evidence: The transcript only asserts in prose that 'The independent adversarial review (gpt-5.6-sol) found two valid issues' with no visible dispatch record (no Task/Agent tool call, no fresh-context spawn, no adversarial prompt shown) — the entire transcript consists of zsh shell commands (git, make, sed) and this claimed review step is never actually invoked as a subagent call.
